comment: New cards in the story (user request, Oct 29): a pick of 3 when you climb out of the Upside-Down (floor), a better one after a boss floor, a rare pick per mystery deduction, and the Town Library's weekly card shelf. Offers use the arena's card pool; waveForWeek maps a story week to the arena wave that sets minWave gates and rarity, plus each source's bonus. Skipping a pick pays skipMoney.
